documents.text: Short-term disability pays 70% of base salary, up to $2,500 a week, for up to 12 weeks after a 7-day waiting period. Recovery from childbirth is covered by short-term disability first; your 16 weeks of parental leave can start after it ends or later within the 12-month window.
